name: financial-modeling-sheet
description: Apply house style to quantitative Excel workbooks through an Excel assistant add-in. Use to create, extend, audit, or restyle workbook layout, input/formula colors, named styles, navigation, dashboards, and Power Query output. Audit mode is read-only. Governs presentation and organization, not arithmetic or ETL.
